newsitem.title: THAILAND: International Trust seeks foreign partners.
newsitem.headline: International Trust seeks foreign partners.

text.p: Thailand's International Trust and Finance Plc said on Wednesday it was negotiating the sale of a stake in the firm with two foreign financial institutions.
In a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand, International Trust said there was no conclusion yet on the negotiations and it did not name the foreign parties.
The bourse on Wednesday halted trading in ITF shares from the afternoon session while awaiting a disclosure from it.
ITF was one of 10 finance firms that was ordered by the central bank in March to raise capital to beat liquidity woes.
ITF said in March that it would issue 130.28 million new shares to raise registered capital to 2.52 billion baht from 1.22 billion baht.
An ITF official declined to give the name of possible foreign buyers of its new shares, saying the negotiation was still in a very early stage.
